entry.name: clip

arguments.name: minimum
arguments.description: The minimum value is the lower limit to the range of output values allowed. If only one argument is present, it is used as both the minimum and maximum limit. If no argument is present, the minimum and maximum limit is 0.

arguments.name: maximum
arguments.description: The maximum value is the upper limit to the range of output values allowed. If only one argument is present, it is used as both the minimum and maximum limit. If no argument is present, the minimum and maximum limit is 0.

messages.name: float
messages.description: The number is sent out the outlet, constrained within the minimum and maximum limits. Theobject adapts the clipped output values to its input, so a floating point input value will output a floating point value regardless of the numeric type specified as an argument.

messages.name: int
messages.description: The number is sent out the outlet, constrained within the minimum and maximum limits specified by the minimum and maximum limits. Theobject adapts the clipped output values to its input, so an integer input value will output an integer value regardless of the numeric type specified as an argument.

messages.name: list
messages.description: Each number in the list is constrained within the minimum and maximum limits, and the constrained numbers are sent out as a list.

messages.name: set
messages.description: The word, followed by two numbers, resets the minimum and maximum limits.
